proves.claim: With inbox.batchedMarks on, a pullboard inbox read with one fresh interrupt and two unread shouts prints all three and writes no board row as the inbox command.

cli.journeys-inbox-no-write.read-writes-.why: Without it, a regression where the inbox read opens the write board again, or the worker stops recording the delivery, would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: After the marks worker drains the spool, a second pullboard inbox names the interrupt only as pending by id and shows neither shout again.

cli.journeys-inbox-no-write.worker-recor.why: Without it, a regression where the inbox read opens the write board again, or the worker stops recording the delivery, would pass unnoticed.
